rootCause: The predictions Native fake returns a nonempty notLoaded turn whose items are empty, but has no thread/items/list branch. The new bounded history adapter requests that native read and receives the generic fallback {}, not a valid empty ThreadItemsListResponse. The failure is not an oversized page, Linux-specific behavior or a timing race.
missedBeforeCI: Previous targeted selection followed media/history/workflow files and actual CLI consumers but omitted predictions.test.ts, whose history preparation is an indirect dependency. Its initial test-file inspection was declaration/import inventory rather than full mock-body semantic inspection. A complete inventory hash does not establish mock compatibility or test execution; CI exposed this omission.
prevention: For any shared native read adapter change, search every RuntimeService thread/history consumer and all thread/turns/list / thread/items/list / thread/timeline/list fake branches, including setup helpers unrelated by test filename.
Classify whether each fake returns no turns, full-turn items, notLoaded turns requiring item pages, or actual pinned CLI responses; execute the complete affected consumer selection before release.
Keep unsupported-read errors and page-limit checks strict; update the fake to the official response schema instead of widening production acceptance or weakening assertions.
Record the original CI and local failures with their source identities. A later targeted pass does not rewrite CI1 as a success.
